description: Free. Upcoming departures at a stop_id, with trip_id, line, scheduled/actual time, current delay and per-row 'delay_source'. Use trip_id as 'trip_id' in plan_transfer for the train the traveller is already on. Read delay_source before reading delay_minutes: 'realtime' means the times are live, so 0 is on time; 'scheduled' means timetable only, so 0 means NOT MEASURED.
name: departures
